description: Yearly cost of owning a bus against charter, a contracted shuttle or rideshare, using only figures the caller supplies. Spreads the purchase over the years kept less resale, adds insurance, maintenance, fuel and driver pay, and names any owning cost left out so a partial answer says it is partial.

alternatives.description: Each quote to compare, e.g. a charter at $1,200 per trip or a shuttle contract at $4,000 per month.

name: compare_own_vs_outsource
